title: Input symbol at the current head position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. The symbol read by the input head of $c$ is the symbol of $x$ at the head's position, with no symbol returned when that position is a boundary blank; equivalently, it is the input symbol at the integer coordinate given by the input-head position.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
